map.由混淆矩阵四类计数推导：准确率衡量整体判对比例，精确率关注\"报为正的有多少真\: Derived from the four confusion-matrix counts: accuracy measures the overall correct proportion, precision focuses on "of those called positive, how many are truly positive", recall focuses on "how many true positives are found", and F1 is their harmonic mean. Accuracy becomes misleading under extreme imbalance, so switch to F1 or the area under the PR curve.

map.精确率 P=TP/(TP+FP) 关注预测为正的纯度；召回 R=TP/(TP+F: Precision P=TP/(TP+FP) focuses on the purity of positive predictions; recall R=TP/(TP+FN) focuses on positive-class coverage.
map.F1=2PR/(P+R) 在类别不平衡时比准确率更可靠。: F1 = 2PR/(P+R) is more reliable than accuracy under class imbalance.
